developments.quant: Rs 370.00 cr cash slump sale to Rane (Madras); ~59.9% of mcap
developments.text: tells the exchanges that **members have approved, by special resolution through a postal ballot declared today, the sale of the Friction Business Undertaking as a going concern on a slump-sale basis** under Section 180(1)(a) and Regulation 37A. **The buyer is Rane (Madras) Limited** — not a promoter or promoter-group entity — and the **consideration is INR 370 crore in cash, subject to transaction adjustments specified in the Business Transfer Agreement, payable on the closing date**. The scale is the point: the undertaking being sold **turned over INR 315.04 crore in FY2025-26, or 84% of the whole company's turnover**, against a **net worth of INR 69.52 crore, 7.50% of the company's**. Completion is **expected on or before 30-Sep-2026**, subject to closing conditions. At ~59.9% of a Rs 617.64 cr market cap this is **the largest proportional transaction on the tape**. **One qualification, because the number is not new:** the BTA was executed on **30-Jun-2026** and today's filing expressly carries forward that intimation's Annexure A — what changed today is that the condition precedent it was subject to, shareholder approval, has been obtained.  Rs 370.00 cr cash slump sale to Rane (Madras); ~59.9% of mcap
